messages:
Ashley (CS): Harbor Retail wants a short APAC pilot and asked for a provisional allowlist + temporary rate bump. They requested 200 qps for the demo window starting tomorrow 08:00 SGT. Can NetOps provision and confirm egress region?
Devon (NetOps): looping in NetOps. need CIDRs, confirmation on Hosted vs Dedicated, and the exact duration.
Ashley (CS): it's Hosted. customer id HRB-2981. CIDRs from customer: 203.110.120.0/22 and 45.77.200.128/25. Duration: 72h starting 2026-05-12T08:00+08:00.
Mike (AM): FYI renewal in ~6 weeks; pilot performance affects upsell. Mark high-touch please.
Elaine (Support): they saw 429 spikes yesterday when traffic routed via EU edge. routing to APAC should help.
Devon (NetOps): can do allowlist + temp rate-limit policy set to 200 qps for those CIDRs and route to ap-southeast-1 edge. auto-revoke after 72h unless CS asks to extend.
Ashley (CS): include autorevoke tag and a 10m canary at 50% traffic for safety.
Devon (NetOps): plan config snippet:
```
allowlist: ["203.110.120.0/22", "45.77.200.128/25"]
route: ap-southeast-1
rate_limit_override: 200 qps
autorevoke: 72h
canary: {duration: 10m, pct: 50}
```
Elaine (Support): add monitoring hook to post to #customer-health and to the account channel if >1% 5xx in 5m.
Devon (NetOps): will add SLO alerting and paging to on-call if severity high.
ops-bot: Change request created CR-20260512-998 — allowlist + rate override for HRB-2981. Scheduled apply: 2026-05-12T07:50:00Z (10m canary). Owner: Devon.
Mike (AM): tagging product-ops — if demo looks good I'll push for Dedicated PoC; need tokens/latency/cost deltas.
Ashley (CS): I'll run the enablement playbook and hand over prompt sets for quality checks; will collect feedback during canary.
Devon (NetOps): deployment steps: pre-checks 07:30 UTC, apply allowlist 07:50 UTC, 10m canary -> monitor, full rollout at 08:00 SGT if healthy. rollback removes override and reverts route.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: deploy/edge-route/CR-20260512-998. ETA 20m.
Elaine (Support): I'll standby on support channel through rollout for customer troubleshooting.
Mike (AM): flagged as renewal-critical; I'll join post-demo review.
Ashley (CS): please paste final applied config and ticket link here after apply so I can confirm with Harbor. :thumbsup:
Devon (NetOps): CR link https://redwood.ops/changes/CR-20260512-998 — will paste applied config after completion.
ops-bot: CR-20260512-998: status changed to SCHEDULED.
Devon (NetOps): applied. final config snapshot is on the ticket. APAC route verified; canary traffic showed 0.2% 5xx. full rollout at 08:00 SGT completed, no issues. Auto-revoke scheduled 72h from rollout time.
Ashley (CS): Harbor reported improved latency and no 429s in first hour. I'll gather more feedback and open renewal conversation post-pilot. :rocket:
